cv2.policy: OpenCV provides deterministic local image decode, registration, template matching and pixel geometry only; no remote model or hidden-information source is allowed, and recognizer outputs remain subject to evidence and fail-closed gates.

faster_whisper.policy: Allowed only as raw ASR base. Bridge semantics, corrections and canonical facts must be produced by school-owned post-processing and evidence rules.

fitz.policy: PyMuPDF is used only to merge, reopen, render and validate PDF artifacts; it must not infer cards, auctions, evidence provenance or canon status.

google.policy: Authentication and Google Drive transport only; must not make bridge-content decisions.

numpy.policy: NumPy provides deterministic local array, numeric and linear-algebra operations only; it must not supply external bridge knowledge, hidden cards or canonical promotion authority.

psycopg.policy: PostgreSQL queue transport, atomic leasing and receipt persistence only; must not make bridge-content or canonical decisions.

reportlab.policy: PDF presentation only; it must render supplied evidence classes without creating card, auction, reconstruction or canon decisions.

requests.policy: HTTP transport only; must not make bridge-content decisions.

sherpa_onnx.policy: Offline speaker segmentation and anonymous embedding inference only. The Oracle container disables the unpinned NeMo compatibility path and uses only the two exact checksum-pinned artifacts; sherpa-onnx must not assign real-person identity or make bridge-content or canonical decisions.
